sketch_notes: The sketches imply a mostly content-centric page with minimal explicit JavaScript. The clearest required interaction is the mobile hamburger navigation in the top header. Mobile also strongly suggests long-scroll reading behavior, making sticky header treatment more likely there than on desktop. Desktop appears comparatively static, with no visible dropdowns, tabs, accordions, forms, or modal triggers. Any incremental content loading is speculative rather than explicit.
